podcast.title: Consideration of a "Beatles Offspring" Band
podcast.body: Sean Lennon was friends with James McCartney, Danny Harrison, and Zach Starkey, and they explored the idea of forming a band together, although it never materialized. "He eventually became friends with Danny Harrison, son of George, Zach Starky, son of Ringo, and Sean Lennon, son of John. They floored with the idea of forming their own band. Imagine that, but nothing ever came of it."

podcast.title: Diverse Musical Career
podcast.body: Sean Lennon, the son of John Lennon and Yoko Ono, has had a varied musical career. He has been a member of multiple bands, composed scores for films, produced material for other artists, and released several solo albums. He has also collaborated with prominent figures such as Albert Hammond Jr. of The Strokes, The Flaming Lips, Lady Gaga, and Lana Del Rey. "Sean Lennon is the son of John and Yoko. He's been in a bunch of different bands, scored some films, produced material for other people, recorded a couple of albums on his own, and collaborated on records with people like Albert Hammond Jr. of the Strokes, The Flaming Lips, Lady Gaga, and Lana Del Rey."

xref.title: Collaborations and Friendship
xref.body: James McCartney has appeared on albums by both his father, Paul McCartney, and his mother, Linda McCartney. He became friends with other Beatles offspring—Danny Harrison, Zach Starkey, and Sean Lennon—and they entertained the idea of forming a band, though it didn't come to fruition. "He's appeared on albums by both Paul and Linda and has several records of his own. He eventually became friends with Danny Harrison, son of George, Zach Starky, son of Ringo, and Sean Lennon, son of John. They floored with the idea of forming their own band. Imagine that, but nothing ever came of it."
